query: Build the SharePoint lists from this spec.
notes: Regression fixture, extracted from a real provisioning workbook: 10 lists, 131 fields, New_Request at 61 fields, Request_Files a document library. Round-trip through generate_workbook.py then xlsx_to_spec.py must preserve all 131 fields.
expected_behavior: Runs validate_lists.py and reports it clean BEFORE generating anything
Generates a workbook with 10 sheets plus a How-to-use sheet
Request_Files is identified as a document library, not a list, because its first field is type file
States that libraries must be created as libraries and cannot be converted from a list
Marks automation-populated columns and says to remove them from the default form
Marks join-key columns and states the delegation reason next to them
Reports list count, per-list field count, and anything it had to assume
Notes that relations[] cannot be inferred from a workbook and must be supplied by hand
fail_if: Treats Request_Files as an ordinary list
Presents output before running the validator
Silently defaults populated_by instead of flagging it
Puts non-ASCII text in a column name rather than in the label row
